cycles.title: Connected Tseitin twins and exact-list sound covers
cycles.result: The toroidal local twins were made primal-connected through a SAT-neutral bridge, and the positive anti-checker route received a witness-independent exact-list circuit upper bound. No terminal result was justified.
cycles.claim_boundary: C019 does not prove P != NP, refute H106, prove H127, or construct the H124 anti-checker.
